description: Paid x402 tool. Get governed public reference data and controlled vocabulary values such as country, currency, unit of measure, industry, status, category, or code mappings. Returns codes, labels, definitions, validity dates, mappings, provenance, and version. Price ID: price.reference.v1.

inputSchema.description: Input for the paid fetch of one governed reference-data code list. Mirrors GET /v1/reference-data/{domain}. Every optional member below is BUILD.md 8.7's, and the semantics are implemented in crates/core/src/operations/reference.rs: query and codes narrow the list, valid_at and include_inactive decide which values are current, limit and cursor page the result.

codes.description: Exact codes wanted. Set membership, never a substring match; omit it to narrow nothing.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor from a prior identical request. Bound to the operation, the normalized request, and the data_version it paged.

domain.description: Reference-data domain identifier, as get_master_data_schema names it.

include_inactive.description: Whether values not KNOWN to be active at valid_at are served. False excludes them; true serves them flagged - active: false for a value declared inactive, beside the reference_value_inactive warning, and active: null for one whose source states no validity interval, beside reference_value_validity_unknown - so an intentionally excluded value is distinguishable from an accidental match. Either warning is carried when such a value is WITHHELD too, so the omission is never silent.

limit.description: Page size, applied after query, codes, and validity have narrowed the list.

locale.description: Language tag echoed on every served value and in the answer. Labels are served exactly as the snapshot stores them; there is no translation layer.

query.description: Optional code or label search: a case-insensitive substring match against a value's code OR its label. Omit it to match every value.

valid_at.description: The instant to evaluate each value's validity interval at. Defaults to the request clock. A value whose source DECLARES its interval is active when valid_from <= valid_at < valid_to, an absent or null bound open on its side. A value whose source states no interval at all is neither: it is served active: null and carries the reference_value_validity_unknown warning.
